tokens.note: primary = Cash Green #00e013 (documented hero color, PMS 802 C; live green CTA bg on cash.app/card). Black #000000 + White #ffffff are the supporting balance pair. Citron #d8ff14 is a sparing high-impact accent (never a full background fill). Live product surfaces use 999px pill buttons in CashSans; brand portal (design.cash.app) is a black canvas with white type.
